All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; Chemical causally affects regulator with an explicit increased or decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; Regulator causally affects gene with an explicit increased or decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. The regulator and downstream disease gene must be different nodes. Ignore composed direction while still requiring increased or decreased direction on each constituent edge. Retrieve both regulatory sign lists, then rematch all raw predicates and qualifiers. A gene present in both lists is counted only once per drug-disease prediction.
hypothesis: Hold every source, constituent-edge qualifier, causal-disease arm, and direct corroboration condition fixed to test whether net-decreasing composition adds specific predictive value beyond signed network proximity or its opposite direction.

derived_features.name: complete signed regulator-to-causal-disease context
derived_features.definition: A regulator has a causes-qualified affects-descendant edge to a distinct downstream gene with increased or decreased activity or activity_or_abundance, and that gene causes or contributes to a disease. Every such regulator-disease context is stored.
inputs: All raw GeneOrGeneProduct-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges in the full Biolink 4.3.2 affects closure, with the stated causal, direction, and activity qualifiers
All raw downstream-gene-to-Disease edges in the complete contributes_to closure, namely causes and contributes_to
Original Neo4j endpoint identity, without treatment labels, external mappings, or feedback data
derived_features.construction: Deduplicate disease neighbors by downstream gene, then regulator-direction pairs by downstream gene. Group all paths by regulator and disease, and collect distinct downstream-gene node element identifiers separately for increased and decreased regulatory directions. Store both lists and their summed length in one relationship. Parallel source edges do not multiply support; a gene with both signs appears in both lists. Missing causal, direction, or aspect qualifiers do not qualify. Empty sign neighborhoods are empty lists. Write complete results in thousand-row transactions; no context is ranked or removed to satisfy resource limits.
derived_features.formula: Ignore composed direction while still requiring increased or decreased direction on each constituent edge. Retrieve both regulatory sign lists, then rematch all raw predicates and qualifiers. A gene present in both lists is counted only once per drug-disease prediction. Prediction support is count(distinct rematched downstream gene nodes), with no numerical support threshold.
derived_features.interpretation: This is computational access, not an additional biological condition or a predictive score. No numerical support threshold is applied. Raw rematching prevents the full affects closure, including ameliorates_condition, from silently contributing excluded evidence. Element identifiers are local to the fixed Neo4j instance. Sign composition does not establish disease risk direction or efficacy.

mechanism.rationale: This is a matched direction control, not a corrective-treatment claim. Gene-disease causation does not establish the risk direction of normal gene function.

execution.cypher_template:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}}
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}}
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,
    context.increased_gene_element_ids + context.decreased_gene_element_ids AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,disease,downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:{{relationship_types:bridge}}]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN {{predicates:bridge}}
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}}
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; bridge: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; The regulator and downstream disease gene must be different nodes.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
This control isolates composed direction under the all-source policy; predictive association is not mechanistic validation.
